stories.headline: Nvidia halves its Asia AI-chip buyer list, adds 'white list' to block China diversions

key_facts.fact: Nvidia has more than halved the number of Asian customers authorized to buy its AI chips after introducing a 'white list' of companies that passed tougher compliance checks to prevent products from reaching China, per an FT report on Monday July 13.
key_facts.excerpt: Nvidia has more than halved the number of Asian customers authorised to buy its AI chips after introducing a 'white list' of companies that passed tougher compliance checks to prevent the products from reaching China, the Financial Times reported on Monday.

key_facts.fact: The company stepped up due diligence in Singapore, Malaysia and Japan, the three jurisdictions that have featured most often in the past two years of chip-diversion cases.
key_facts.excerpt: stepped up due diligence in Singapore, Malaysia, and Japan, the three jurisdictions that have featured most often in the past two years of chip-diversion cases.

key_facts.fact: More than half of Nvidia's previous customers, particularly neo-cloud providers, failed the initial review and were removed from the list, though they can reapply after making changes.
key_facts.excerpt: More than half of its previous customers, particularly neo-cloud providers, failed the initial review and were removed from the list, though they can reapply after making changes, the report added.

key_facts.fact: Nvidia staff now visit customers' data centres, verify contracts and interview end users as part of the tightened checks, following pressure from Washington.
key_facts.excerpt: staff now visit customers' data centres, verify contracts and interview end users as part of the checks.

key_facts.fact: On May 31 the Commerce Department's Bureau of Industry and Security issued guidance clarifying that an export licence is required for advanced computing chips going to any entity whose ultimate parent is headquartered in China or Macau, wherever it sits.
key_facts.excerpt: On 31 May, the Commerce Department's Bureau of Industry and Security issued guidance clarifying that an export licence is required for advanced computing chips going to any entity whose ultimate parent is headquartered in China or Macau, wherever that entity happens to sit.

stories.headline: Google to buy full initial output of Cypress Creek's 1.6GW Arkansas solar project for data-center power

key_facts.fact: Google agreed to buy the entire initial output of the 1.6GW Steel River Energy Center in Arkansas under a virtual power purchase agreement, the FT reported on July 14.
key_facts.excerpt: Google has agreed to buy the entire initial output of the 1.6GW Steel River Energy Center in Arkansas under a virtual power purchase agreement, the Financial Times has reported.

key_facts.fact: Google will take 100% of the project's initial output when it becomes operational in 2029, covering 1.6GW of solar and 2GWh of battery storage, with the project expected to expand to 2.5GW of solar and 2.9GWh of storage on completion.
key_facts.excerpt: Google will take 100% of the project's initial output when it becomes operational in 2029, covering 1.6GW of solar generation and 2GWh of battery storage, with the project expected to expand to 2.5GW of solar and 2.9GWh of storage on completion.

key_facts.fact: Cypress Creek Energy CEO Kevin Smith called the agreement a rare bright spot for the US solar sector, noting technology companies increasingly seek large renewable projects to match rising electricity demand; financial terms were not disclosed.
key_facts.excerpt: Cypress Creek Energy chief executive Kevin Smith told the FT the agreement is a rare bright spot for the US solar sector and said technology companies were increasingly seeking large renewable energy projects to match rising electricity demand.

key_facts.fact: Steel River will use 100% domestically sourced First Solar panels, Arkansas steel and LG Phoenix batteries; Cypress Creek previously secured $3.5 billion in financing for phases one and two, fully underwritten by Barclays, BNP Paribas, Santander and Wells Fargo.
key_facts.excerpt: Steel River will use 100% domestically sourced First Solar panels, Arkansas steel, and LG Phoenix batteries, reflecting developers' response to stricter tax credit and supply chain constraints.

key_facts.fact: Google's electricity use surged 37% in 2025 and, alongside other Big Tech firms, drove 49% of corporate clean power deals that year.
key_facts.excerpt: Google's electricity use surged 37% in 2025 and, alongside other Big Tech firms, drove 49% of corporate clean power deals that year, intensifying demand for renewable projects.

stories.headline: New York becomes first US state to enact a data-center moratorium via Hochul executive order

key_facts.fact: Governor Kathy Hochul signed the nation's first statewide data-center moratorium via executive order, blocking new environmental permits for data centers over 50 megawatts for up to a year.
key_facts.excerpt: The order blocks new environmental permits for data centers over 50 megawatts, which the governor's office says will give the state time to come up with the regulations needed to protect residents from rising energy prices and environmental impact.

key_facts.fact: The 50MW threshold is higher than the 20MW threshold approved by state lawmakers; Hochul's office says it is meant to prevent disruption to smaller data centers used by institutions like hospitals.
key_facts.excerpt: That's higher than the 20 megawatt threshold approved by state lawmakers... the threshold is meant to prevent disruption to smaller data centers used by institutions like hospitals.

key_facts.fact: The Senate and Assembly both passed a one-year data center moratorium that Hochul did not sign; instead she issued an executive order taking effect immediately, and has not said whether she will sign the legislature's bill.
key_facts.excerpt: The state Senate and Assembly both passed a one-year data center moratorium this year that Hochul did not sign. Instead, the governor will issue an executive order that takes effect immediately and gives more direction to state agencies.

key_facts.fact: Developers have requested grid connections for more than 30 hyperscale projects in New York, each using enough power for a small- or medium-sized city; together they would use more power than Ireland.
key_facts.excerpt: Developers have requested grid connections for more than 30 hyperscale projects, each of which would use enough power for a small- or medium-sized city. Together, they would use more power than Ireland.

key_facts.fact: The Department of Environmental Conservation was ordered not to issue permits to new data centers until a generic environmental impact statement is developed; Hochul also plans to push to repeal sales tax exemptions for large data centers.
key_facts.excerpt: Hochul also said Tuesday she plans to push the legislature to roll back sales tax exemptions for large data centers in the state when they're back in session next year.

stories.headline: Meta expands Louisiana Hyperion AI campus to 5GW, lifting investment past $50B

key_facts.fact: Meta announced Monday July 13 that its Hyperion campus in Richland Parish, Louisiana will scale to 5GW of compute and require more than $50 billion in investment, up from the roughly $27 billion plan announced in 2025.
key_facts.excerpt: The company said Monday the Richland Parish campus will ultimately scale to 5 GW and require more than $50 billion in investment, up from the roughly $27 billion plan announced in 2025 through a joint venture with Blue Owl Capital. The first phase remains on track to deliver about 2 GW by 2030.

key_facts.fact: Hyperion will draw electricity from 10 new power plants (including seven new natural gas plants) built by utility Entergy, plus 1.5GW of solar generation and storage, with Entergy building more than 100 miles of transmission lines to link the systems.
key_facts.excerpt: Hyperion will draw electricity from 10 new power plants that are set to be built by Entergy Corp., a local utility. The latter company also plans to install 1.5 gigawatts of solar power generation and storage equipment. Entergy will reportedly build more than 100 miles of transmission lines to link the new energy systems with Hyperion.

key_facts.fact: The most advanced accelerator in the Hyperion lineup is Meta's MTI 500, delivering 30 petaflops of MX4 performance, twice as fast as the current MTI 400, while using about 40% more electricity.
key_facts.excerpt: The most advanced accelerator in the lineup is known as the MTI 500. It will provide 30 petaflops of MX4 performance, which will make it twice as fast as Meta's current-generation MTI 400 chip. The MTI 500 also uses about 40% more electricity.

key_facts.fact: The $50 billion budget excludes chips; factoring in processors and related items reportedly raises the total price tag to about $250 billion, per Bloomberg.
key_facts.excerpt: According to Bloomberg, the $50 billion project budget shared by Meta today doesn't include the chips that Hyperion will host. Factoring in processors and certain related items reportedly increases the price tag to $250 billion.

key_facts.fact: Meta says the expansion includes an energy agreement expected to save Entergy Louisiana customers more than $2 billion over 20 years, and that it will cover the data center's energy, water and infrastructure costs.
key_facts.excerpt: Meta said the expansion includes an energy agreement expected to save Entergy Louisiana customers more than $2 billion over 20 years. The company said it will cover the data center's energy, water and infrastructure costs.

stories.headline: China's LimX Dynamics raises $200M pre-IPO at $2.2B as humanoid startups rush to list

key_facts.fact: Humanoid startup LimX Dynamics announced on Tuesday July 14 it closed a $200 million pre-IPO round valuing the company at 15 billion yuan ($2.21 billion).
key_facts.excerpt: Humanoid startup LimX raised $200 million in a pre-IPO round that values the company at $2.21 billion.

key_facts.fact: Founder Will Zhang said 'Listing is a must,' with the startup already preparing for an IPO — likely in Hong Kong — and in a confidential phase of review.
key_facts.excerpt: 'Listing is a must,' said founder Will Zhang... The startup said it was already preparing for its IPO, likely in Hong Kong, and is in a confidential phase of review.

key_facts.fact: Overseas investors including UAE-based Stone Venture, Italy-based GGG and Germany-based Redstone VC joined the round, alongside Lens Technology, IDG Capital, WestSummit Capital, Nio Capital and Hefei Binhu Industry Development Group.

stories.headline: Mitsubishi Motors, Highlanders sign MOU to mass-produce humanoid robots at Kyoto plant

key_facts.fact: Mitsubishi Motors and Highlanders, a University of Tokyo startup, announced on July 13 they signed an MOU to jointly develop humanoid robots for Mitsubishi's factories and to explore mass-producing Highlanders' robots at Mitsubishi's Kyoto Plant.
key_facts.excerpt: TOKYO, July 13, 2026 - (JCN Newswire) - Mitsubishi Motors Corporation... and Highlanders, Inc.... a startup originating from the University of Tokyo, today announced that they have signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU)... the two companies will explore the joint development of humanoid robots for use at Mitsubishi Motors' manufacturing facilities as well as mass production of Highlanders products at Mitsubishi Motors' Kyoto Plant.

key_facts.fact: The companies will examine the feasibility of commencing production in early 2027 by using currently unused buildings at the Kyoto Plant.
key_facts.excerpt: The companies will examine the feasibility of commencing production in early 2027 by utilizing currently unused buildings at Mitsubishi Motors' Kyoto Plant.

key_facts.fact: As a first step Mitsubishi Motors will deploy Highlanders' humanoid robots at its own facilities to accumulate operational data and know-how.
key_facts.excerpt: Mitsubishi Motors plans to utilize humanoid robots at its own manufacturing facilities. Through practical use, the company will accumulate operational data and know-how while deepening its expertise in the field of humanoid robotics.

key_facts.fact: Mitsubishi has already invested in Highlanders and plans further investment; the tie-up is billed as the first collaboration between an automaker and a humanoid developer specifically targeting large-scale humanoid production.
key_facts.excerpt: Mitsubishi has already made an investment in Highlanders and says it plans to make further investments. This marks what the companies claim is the first collaboration between an automotive manufacturer and a humanoid robotics developer specifically targeting large-scale humanoid production.
